summary: Imports from an __init__.py in an embedded plugin become part of the collection and must name the file explicitly, as in importing CustomBaseClass from plugins.callback.__init__.
questions: How do I import a base class from a callback plugin's __init__.py in a collection?

answer_card.title: Importing from __init__.py after migration
answer_card.answer_md:
Use the filename in the import:
```python
from ansible_collections.ansible_example.community.plugins.callback.__init__ import CustomBaseClass
```
Or keep that content in a standalone role.
